readerCopy.body: A current power struggle can become much larger when it touches the same place where wanting something once came with punishment. When Pluto squares Lilith, control and refusal create friction until the present decision starts carrying the force of an older history of being silenced or overruled. The determination to win can make exposure, withholding, or forcing an admission look necessary. The history matters, but the current leverage and the term that actually needs to change still belong to the present.
